longForm.overview:

It encodes comoros's national identity in two regional-indicator letters, which is why it travels cleanly across keyboards and renders the same on iOS, Android, and the web.

In real-world usage 🇰🇲 lives in the spaces where the sender wants to flag where they are from, where they're going, or which team they're rooting for. A sports thread fills up with 🇰🇲 during comoros matches. A diaspora chat uses 🇰🇲 as a soft hello between comoros speakers. A traveler captions a comoros story with 🇰🇲 so the post reads at a glance. The flag's simplicity is what makes it flexible — the cue can carry hometown pride, sports loyalty, travel geography, or simply a one-tap ack.

What separates 🇰🇲 from the broader flag family is its specificity. Unlike a generic globe (🌍) or a regional cluster, 🇰🇲 points to one country only. That is why it travels especially well on World Cup threads, Olympics coverage, election night posts, and any context where the sender wants the message to land with comoros energy in a single tap.
